p: Represents an interactive UI element within the graphical user interface. This structure encapsulates information necessary to enable interactivity for a specific visual region or shape, including rectangle or custom-defined shapes, and associates it with a graphical user interface context to handle various user interactions.
Determines whether the specified interaction type is occurring on the element.

ul.li: mask (Interactions): The type of interaction(s) to check for, specified as a combination of one or more Interactions flags.
True if the specified interaction(s) are occurring on the element; otherwise, false.

p: Determines if the mouse cursor is currently hovering over the interactive element's defined shape or boundary within the associated GUI context.

ul.li: True if the cursor is within the interactive region of the element; otherwise, false.

p: Determines whether the specified mouse button is currently being held down on the interactive element.

ul.li: button (MouseButton): The mouse button to check, defaulting to the left button if not specified. (Default: MouseButton.Left)
True if the specified mouse button is being held down; otherwise, false.

p: Determines if the interactive element is currently being held by the user, and provides details about the hold interaction, such as the start and current positions.

ul.li: args (HoldArgs): When the method returns true, contains details about the hold interaction. The details include the starting position of the hold and the current mouse position.
True if the interactive element is being held; otherwise, false.

p: Determines if the specified mouse button was clicked while the interactive element is hovered.

ul.li: button (MouseButton): The mouse button to check for the click interaction. Defaults to Left. (Default: MouseButton.Left)
True if the specified mouse button was clicked and the interactive element is hovered; otherwise, false.
